tools.name: create_static_qr
tools.description: Encode a URL or text into a QR code image. Nothing is stored. Works without signing in.

tools.name: create_fixed_link
tools.description: Create a fixed (non-editable) short link and QR on your Qorlie account. Counts toward your monthly free links.

tools.name: create_dynamic_qr
tools.description: Create an editable short link and QR you can change later. Needs an Editable credit or a plan that includes editable codes.

tools.name: update_dynamic_qr
tools.description: Change the destination URL or title of an editable code. Locked links must be unlocked in the app first.

tools.name: list_dynamic_qrs
tools.description: List all of your codes and links (fixed and editable), with an editable flag on each.

tools.name: get_qr_analytics
tools.description: Pull scan stats for one of your codes. Detail depends on your plan.

tools.name: get_account_analytics
tools.description: Pull account-wide scan rollups for your codes.

tools.name: get_plan
tools.description: Show your plan name, links used this month, editable credits left, scans vs included, and which features you have.

tools.name: import_bitly_csv
tools.description: Preview a Bitly CSV import cost. Needs Scan Pass or Business. Confirm creates via the app or REST.

tools.name: bulk_create_dynamic_qrs
tools.description: Create multiple editable codes at once. Needs Scan Pass or Business.
